PanaLuxPointCurveBlacksUp.label: Point Curve Black Point Up
PanaLuxPointCurveBlacksUp.explanation: Adjust a composite SDR curve endpoint. Requires updated PanaLux Bridge, selected photo in Develop, and verified SDR mode. Unsupported curve data is left unchanged.
